definitions.gloss: the ocean; the open sea; the vast sea
definitions.explanation: The great, open expanse of the sea, emphasizing its vastness. A somewhat literary word that often appears in metaphors contrasting something small with the immensity of the sea.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}が{大海|たいかい}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: The ship sailed out into the open sea.

examples.japanese: {大海|たいかい}の{真|ま}ん{中|なか}で{方向|ほうこう}を{見失|みうしな}った。
examples.english: We lost our bearings in the middle of the open sea.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{知識|ちしき}など、{大海|たいかい}の{一滴|いってき}にすぎないと{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I felt that my own knowledge was no more than a drop in the ocean.

notes:
A literary, somewhat grand word for the open sea, stressing its vastness. In everyday conversation {海|うみ} is far more common.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大海|たいかい}の{一滴|いってき}: a drop in the ocean — something tiny and insignificant by comparison
- {大海|たいかい}に{乗|の}り{出|だ}す: to set out onto the open sea (often figurative, e.g. into the wider world)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {海|うみ}: sea — the everyday, neutral word
- {大洋|たいよう}: ocean — a more technical/geographical term for the major oceans (Pacific, Atlantic, etc.)
